verdict.rationale: Trace and log sampling and retention controls are a fair axis for an observability platform like Sentry. However, the evidence pack never documents sample-rate configuration, dynamic sampling, log filtering, or retention tiers. Trace ingestion and exploration evidence (OTLP endpoints, Trace Explorer) covers collecting and querying data, not deliberately controlling its volume or retention.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately
